description: Modify an existing vendor credit. Can update vendor, date, memo, ref number, and/or lines. For lines: provide line_id to update existing line, omit line_id to add new line (requires amount and account_name), set delete=true to remove. A line_id preserves the line's existing customer unless customer_name/customer_id is given; pass customer_name: "" to clear it. Note: DepartmentRef is header-level only — lines do not support department.

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without saving (default: true)

lines.description: Line modifications. Provide line_id to update existing line, omit to add new line.

account_name.description: Account name or number (auto-resolved to ID)

customer_id.description: Customer ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use customer_name)

customer_name.description: Customer or project this line is attributed to (auto-resolved to ID). Omit to keep the line's current customer; pass "" to clear it. Vendor credit lines accept a customer only — the vendor is the header vendor_name.

delete.description: Set true to remove this line (requires line_id)

line_id.description: ID of existing line to update (omit for new line)

txn_date.description: New transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

vendor_name.description: New vendor display name (auto-resolved to ID)

name: edit_vendor_credit
